_readme: Our corrected copy of a few golden labels. data/GOLDEN-DATASETS.json is never edited; retrieval_check.py prints the original score and the adjusted one. 'optional' documents are not required for the adjusted score.

SIMPLE_004.reason: SLA question. The contract holds the SLA (P1 4 hours, P2 next business day); the login article has no SLA text. It might be listed as related Webex support material, so it is optional, not wrong.

WF_WEBEX_001.reason: Workflow question that needs several documents: 5 expected in 5 slots leaves no room for any other hit. Scored at 8; the login article is useful but not required.

WF_ONBOARD_001.reason: Same 5 documents (label is reasonable) but a workflow question; scored at 8 instead of 5 slots.
